text:
Maria: Heads-up — after the kernel 6.x rollout to a subset of hosts in us-west-2 we're seeing GPU modules fail to load, hosts flapping, and a couple of NVLink errors in dmesg.
Tom: ugh, which kernel exactly? 6.1? 6.2?
Maria: 6.1.12-rt + our standard DKMS nvidia package. 6.1 is the bulk, a handful were 6.2.
Kevin: error snippets?
Maria: Paste from one affected host:
```
[  123.456789] nvidia: disagrees about version of symbol module_layout
[  123.456800] nvidia: Unknown symbol: nvlink_init (err 0)
[  123.456811] nvidia: failed to register with NVML, driver init failed
[  123.456820] NVRM: GPU 0000:65:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus
[  123.456830] Out of memory: Kill process 2345 (python) score 987
```
Tom: that `module_layout` message screams kernel headers mismatch / DKMS build against wrong headers. Did the upgrade change header package name?
Sara: I also see `nvidia-uvm` not present on a few machines. `dkms status` shows rebuilt modules for the new kernel on some, but on others it failed with a missing `linux-headers-6.1` package.
Maria: Affected footprint: ~25 hosts in us-west-2 (gpu-pool-1), 9 hosts in eu-central-1, and 3 in ap-southeast-1. Not a total fleet outage but steady degradation of our preemptible capacity.
deploy-bot: [deploy] kernel-rollout-6x to gpu-pool-1: partial -> failure (25/120 hosts failed post-upgrade)
Kevin: Are we seeing NCCL hangs or just kernel/drivers?
Maria: NCCL shows multi-peer comms errors where NVLink was expected; some jobs fail with `NCCL NET/IB` fallback but latency spikes.
ops-oncall: Currently draining the worst hosts in us-west-2 and moving jobs to dedicated fallback pool. Need a rollback window?
Tom: Yes — can we pin the fleet back to 5.15 for the affected nodes? We should avoid a full rollback unless necessary. Plan: 1) tag hosts with `gpu:bad-driver` 2) drain and reprovision from 5.15 AMIs for the worst 25 3) run DKMS rebuild and smoke-test 4) run small NCCL canary jobs.
Sara: I tried `modinfo nvidia` on a failing host and got `modinfo: ERROR: Module nvidia not found.` `uname -a` shows `6.1.12-rt`. Headers present at `/usr/src/linux-headers-6.1.12` on some hosts but the DKMS build log shows `gcc: error: unrecognized command line option ‘-mno-sse3’` on older toolchains.
Tom: Toolchain mismatch — some AMIs still had gcc 7.x we phased out. New kernels expect newer toolchain. That's why DKMS didn't produce a usable `.ko`.
Maria: For mitigation I propose: roll back the kernel on the 25 affected us-west-2 hosts to the previous 5.15 images (AMI rollback + reboot), mark as `gpu:stable`, then schedule a controlled 6.x re-rollout with the toolchain fix and explicit kernel-headers package in the AMI.
Kevin: Also we should update the kernel upgrade playbook to check `dkms status` and `modinfo` in the post-upgrade healthcheck and abort if `module_layout` mismatch appears. Add `lspci -k` check to ensure the driver is bound.
Sara: Agreed. I'll open a PR to the playbook repo with the checks and a `preflight` action: ensure `gcc >= 9` and `linux-headers` for target kernel are installed before reboot.
ops-oncall: Can we get a quick list of affected host IDs? Maria: Uploading to incident ticket now with node list and kube node names.
Tom: Cost/region note — us-west-2 fallback pool is lower capacity; draining 25 nodes will push some queued jobs to lower-priority regions and could increase egress costs. Keep Finance in the loop if this extends beyond the 3-hour window.
Maria: Timeline: start rollback now, expected 60–90 mins for drain/provision/validation for the first batch of 10; then repeat. Will update the ticket.
Kevin: Long term action items: rebuild golden AMIs with consistent toolchain, bake kernel-headers into image, add automatic DKMS build verification at bake time, and add a canary group for kernel+driver upgrades limited to 3 hosts.
Sara: I'll also add an alert for `dmesg` patterns: `disagrees about version of symbol module_layout`, `Unknown symbol: nvlink_init`, and `GPU has fallen off the bus` so we detect earlier.
deploy-bot: [incident] created: INC-2026-349 GPU driver mismatch after kernel 6.x rollout (link to ticket)
Maria: OK moving to execute rollback on batch-1. Adding :eyes: reactions to the playbook PR when open. Will post updates every 15m.
Tom: Thanks — ping me for verification on canary jobs.
Sara: PR: https://git.internal/repo/playbooks/pull/482 — added checks & toolchain gating.
Maria: Update 15m: rollback batch-1 complete, 10 nodes reprovisioned to 5.15 AMI, `modinfo nvidia` reports module present, smoke NCCL job passed. Continuing with batch-2.
ops-oncall: Monitoring cluster health, moving any critical jobs to Dedicated pool if they degrade.
Kevin: Great work. After full rollback let's schedule a maintenance window to coordinate a properly-baked 6.x rollout with the infra team.
